top_signals.title: Mittal: Clear Govt Policy Made UAE an Expansion Hub
top_signals.summary: Shravin Mittal, Founder & CEO of Unbound, joined Horizons Middle East and Africa from the inaugural Bloomberg Invest Dubai where some of the world’s leading investors, family offices and business leaders gathered to discuss the future of wealth and where capital is moving next. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia Slumps on Reports CEO Huang Could Be Out: Street Wrap
top_signals.summary: Nvidia Corp. shares sank 7.4% on Tradegate following reports the AI chipmaker’s board is working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The move follows reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy. The Wall Street Journal said the board is preparing to oust Huang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
